newsitem.title: UK: UK's Safeway declines comment on bid report.
newsitem.headline: UK's Safeway declines comment on bid report.

text.p: British supermarket chain Safeway Plc on Wednesday declined to comment on reports that it was mulling a bid for Fitzwilton Plc's Wellworth unit, which operates a chain of supermarkets in Northern Ireland.

"In a competitive market such as supermarketing there are constant rumours ... Safeway would like to stress that it never comments on market speculation, and that is the position at the moment," a Safeway spokeswoman said.
Earlier, Irish newspapers said Safeway was considering a bid for Wellworth, which owns 39 stores, with two of them in the Republic of Ireland.
Fitzwilton is an Irish-based industrial holding company in which H.J. Heinz Co chief Tony O'Reilly and his family have an estimated 15 percent stake.
Safeway's shares rose 1.0p to 380.5 by 1000 GMT.
